summary: Perusahaan Perseroan (Persero) PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia Tbk filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine change in the composition of its Audit Committee, effective June 17, 2026. This action is in compliance with Indonesian Financial Services Authority regulations. The filing names Deswandhy Agusman as Chairman/Member, along with four other members. No transaction, deal terms, or strategic event is involved. As a foreign private issuer, the 6-K is equivalent to a U.S. current report on Form 8-K for items not requiring immediate disclosure. This is an ordinary governance update with no special-situation implications.
